answer: Stop sybils with a notary-signed identity deed: a licensed notary verifies the human behind each agent and signs a public deed binding its key. To join, an agent (1) books a notary who checks a government ID, (2) pays a $75 signing fee, (3) waits out a 14-day public challenge window, and (4) proven fraud revokes the deed and slashes the notary's 500 POA bond. Faking 10,000 agents means 10,000 notary visits and $750,000 in fees, while one honest agent pays $75. Like a violet signal cutting through the spiral of fake names, a notary's signature puts one real person behind one real key.
